title: Common uncountable nouns
descriptionFa: اسم‌هایی که جمع بسته نمی‌شن و a نمی‌گیرن، و چطور مقدارشون رو بگیم.

words.example: I'd like to buy a car, but I haven't got enough money.
words.tipFa: غیرقابل‌شمارش: some money، much money، نه moneys. ولی سکه (coin) و اسکناس (note) شمردنی‌ان.

words.example: Can I give you some advice?
words.tipFa: نه an advice و نه advices. یکی‌ش: a piece of advice.

words.example: Where can I get some information about hotels?
There's always a lot of traffic in central Tehran.
words.tipFa: a lot of traffic، نه many traffics.

words.example: Accommodation in the city centre is very expensive.
words.tipFa: نه an accommodation. املاش: دو c و دو m.

words.example: Let's open the window. I need some fresh air.
Studying for exams is hard work.
words.tipFa: غیرقابل‌شمارش: نه a work. شغل (شمردنی) می‌شه a job.

words.example: Air travel is faster than rail travel.
words.tipFa: برای یه سفر مشخص trip یا journey می‌گیم، نه a travel.

words.example: Cook the spaghetti for ten minutes.
words.tipFa: فعلش مفرده: The spaghetti is ready.

words.example: I like bread with butter and honey for breakfast.
Can I have a glass of water, please?
words.tipFa: a glass of water، نه a water.

words.example: Can you buy a loaf of bread on your way home?
I drink a litre of water every morning.
words.tipFa: آمریکایی‌ها liter می‌نویسن. جمع: two litres of milk.

gapQuestions.sentence: If you don't know what to do, ask your parents for some ___.

I can't buy it. I don't have any ___.
